title: Algorithmic Inheritance: Surname Bias in AI Decisions Reinforces Intergenerational Inequality

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual surname substitution in decision-making prompts (e.g., hiring, leadership appointments, and loan approvals), measuring how surnames categorized as 'Rich', 'Legacy', 'Normal', and 'Variant' affect AI perceptions of intelligence, power, and wealth across varying levels of objective candidate qualifications using GPT-4o-mini.
